<entry id="L00160">
<head-word>לָהַט</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. להב)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to glisten, glow</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 21, end מי מציל … מאש לוֹהֶטֶת זו what will save my children from this glowing fire (hell)?; a. e.—Part. pass. לָהוּט, f. לְהוּטָה; pl. לְהוּטִים, לְהוּטִין; לְהוּטוֹת 
<italic>glowing;</italic> (with אחר) 
<italic>passionately following, anxious for</italic>. Gen. R. s. 94 ל' אחר גרונו, v. גָּרוֹן. Y. Taan. VI, 69
<sup>b</sup>; Pesik Dibré, p. 114
<sup>a</sup> שהיו ישראל ל' אחר וכ' (not שיהו) the Israelites were greedy for sweet things. Gen. R. s. 22 היו ל' אחר האדמה had a passion for agriculture. Cant. R. to I, 4 ל' … אחרי שכינה the Israelites were anxious for the Divine Presence; a. fr.—Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 4 (ref. to Ps. LVII, 5) שהיו לוֹהֲטִים אחר לה"ר (= לְהוּטִים) they had a passion for denunciation; Midr. Till. to Ps. VII; Yalk. ib. 637; Yalk. Kings 213 להוטים; Y. Peah I, 16
<sup>a</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>לִיהֵט</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to glow</italic>; 
<italic>to make glowing</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 16 האש מְלַהֶטֶת סביבותיו the fire was shining around him. Gen. R. s. 21, end (ref. to Gen. III, 24) שהיא מתהפכת … ומְלַהַטְתּוֹ וכ' it (the fire of hell) turns around man and heats him through from top to bottom &c. Num. R. s. 18 לִיהֲטוֹ האש the fire seized him; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>
